title: Private planning bootstrap
description: Establish the private planning lane for auxide kernel work. Use this epic to track architecture, runtime-control, testing, and release work that should not live in the public repo until curated.

title: Design first-class runtime control for external DSP nodes
description: Define the control-plane contract needed so external nodes from auxide-dsp can be modulated at runtime without rebuilding the graph. Cover plan representation, RT-safe parameter transport, and host/runtime control APIs.

title: Implement RT-safe runtime control plane for external nodes
description: Replace the shipped snapshot's legacy-only runtime with a split runtime/control model that can execute external nodes and accept live parameter changes without rebuilding the graph. Keep the implementation RT-safe and avoid per-block allocation in the audio path.
acceptance_criteria: runtime exposes a control-capable handle/core split or equivalent RT-safe control surface; external nodes execute in the runtime; live parameter updates reach running graphs; no per-block Vec allocation remains in the RT path

title: Add external node support to graph and plan
description: Bring the shipped snapshot's graph/compiler layer up to the required external-node model. Add a NodeType::External path, add_external_node(), and the plan/compiler handling needed so external DSP node definitions can exist in compiled graphs.
acceptance_criteria: graph.rs defines NodeType::External and add_external_node(); plan compilation accepts external nodes; tests cover external node graph construction and compile ordering
notes: Closed after syncing the saved graph/planner/runtime repair to disk and validating with cargo test --workspace. External node support is now present in graph.rs/plan.rs/rt.rs and the workspace test suite passes.

title: Verify full-suite end-to-end compile and test across all four crates
description: Context: the suite assessment notes auxide to auxide-io API drift (legacy RuntimeHandle / Runtime::sample_rate) that broke the full stack even though individual crates looked mature. Evidence: AUXIDE_SUITE_ASSESSMENT_2026-03-06.md:159-176. Definition of Done: after the kernel external-node control work lands, the full four-crate suite compiles and all tests pass from a single shared manifest; the cross-crate API is consistent.
acceptance_criteria: full suite compiles from one shared manifest; cargo test passes for all four crates; cross-crate API consistent
